description: This PHP source file defines the CollectionEndpoint interface within the OrangeHRM Core API v2. It specifies methods for retrieving, creating, and deleting resource collections, along with validation rules, and includes relevant exception handling. The interface serves as a contract for implementing classes managing resource collections in the API.

classes.name: CollectionEndpoint
classes.description: An interface defining collection operations such as getting all resources, creating, deleting, and obtaining validation rules, along with associated exceptions for error handling.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of resources, potentially throwing exceptions related to normalization, unimplemented features, missing records, or access restrictions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll operation, possibly throwing a not implemented exception.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new resource and returns the result, with exception potential similar to getAll.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a resource, may throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a list of resources, with exception handling for various error conditions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, may throw a not implemented exception.
